method: Lossless export of archived J-V optics.x_nm/G_cm3_s/layer_index; no simulation rerun or interpolation of CSV data.
integral: J_photo[mA/cm2] = q * trapezoid(G[cm^-3 s^-1], x[nm]) * 1e-7 * 1e3; q=1.602176634e-19 C
coordinate: x=0 is the left edge of electrical NiOx. Perovskite nominally spans x=20..820 nm. C60 spans 820..860 nm. External Air/Ag optical layers are not included in x. Original native layer IDs are retained, including interface-adjacent assignments that can cross nominal boundaries; derived layer_x_nm may be slightly negative.
spectrum: Original AM1.5G, 300..800 nm, full-spectrum Pin=100 mW/cm2, Air left incidence. Original n,k and gap-reference assumptions are preserved.
